node_greeting.speaker: char_abenthy
node_greeting.text: The world wears a thousand quiet faces, lad. Most folk rush past them, but a trouper learns to see the shape beneath the skin. What do you see when you look at me?

choices.text: A man who knows more than his smile shows.

node_question.speaker: char_abenthy
node_question.text: Clever eyes. Remember this: every art has three bones — a source that feeds it, a link that shapes it, and a target that bears it. Forget the bones and the art collapses.

node_deflect.speaker: char_abenthy
node_deflect.text: A careful answer. Careful is wise, but careful can also be a cage. Still, I suspect the curiosity is there — it only needs a nudge.
